images.title: Finding the missing weight
images.purpose: Shows the total 392 from mean times count, split into the 9 known weights 349 and the missing weight 43.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One long horizontal bar in the centre with a brace above it and two parts below.
images.exact_structure: One long horizontal bar, outlined in dark, split into two parts: a long teal (#0072B2) part on the left about nine tenths of the bar, and a short amber (#E69F00) part on the right about one tenth of the bar. A brace over the whole bar carries the label total = 39.2 × 10 = 392. Inside or just below the teal part: 9 known weights = 349. Inside or just below the amber part: w = 43 kg. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Mean times count gives the total; the missing value is what is left after the known values.
images.description: Shows the total 392 from mean times count, split into the 9 known weights 349 and the missing weight 43.
images.context: Mean weight 39.2 kg of 10 wrestlers; nine known weights add to 349; 392 minus 349 is 43.

image_decisions.why: The bar model shows why the total comes first and the unknown is the leftover piece.
